canonicalIdentity.gap: The mutation engine is not yet keyed by canonical patientId and encounterId.

create.currentAuthorization: Valid session and booking context; no explicit staff permission on the mutation routes.
create.currentAudit: Mutable engine record plus booking-case events; no append-only ccoAuditLog event.
create.currentIdempotency: No required idempotency key; retries can append duplicate case events and repeat side effects.
create.currentFailureHandling: 4xx conflicts are returned, but engine, case, patient360, journal and notification writes are not one transaction.
create.currentRecovery: No explicit rollback endpoint; compensating cancellation would be required after a partial confirm flow.
requiredBeforeGo: bookings.write permission with fail-closed staff role
canonical patientId binding and explicit encounter policy
required idempotency key with payload fingerprint
append-only audit event before and after mutation
preflight of slot, service, resource and treatment gate
documented compensation for partial downstream writes
mail and notification side effects behind an explicit post-commit policy

move.currentAuthorization: Calendar rebook requires OWNER or STAFF; generic engine rebook only requires a valid session and booking context.
move.currentAudit: Booking chain fields and booking-case event exist; no append-only ccoAuditLog event.
move.currentFailureHandling: The store saves cancel, reserve and confirm separately.
move.currentRecovery: No automatic compensation; a failed reserve or confirm can leave the previous booking cancelled.
requiredBeforeGo: single preflight before cancelling the old booking
atomic transaction or tested compensation that restores the previous booking
expected booking version to reject stale drag or double submit

cancel.currentAuthorization: Valid session and booking context; no explicit staff permission on the mutation route.
cancel.currentAudit: cancelledBy and booking-case event exist; no append-only ccoAuditLog event.
cancel.currentIdempotency: No required idempotency key; a retry returns no active booking instead of replaying the first result.
cancel.currentFailureHandling: Booking is persisted before patient360 and notification side effects; email failures are swallowed as skipped.
cancel.currentRecovery: No restore endpoint; recovery requires recreating the exact prior booking.
requiredBeforeGo: all create authorization, canonical identity, idempotency and audit gates
expected booking version and explicit cancellation reason
read-only confirmation preview with policy impact
tested restore or exact compensating recreate procedure
notification policy separated from the booking commit

recommendedFirstFlow.name: Create booking preflight
recommendedFirstFlow.description: Show canonical patient, proposed service/resource/time, encounter policy, provider capability and every unmet gate. Do not expose a confirm button.
recommendedFirstFlow.futureMutationAfterGo: Reserve then confirm a new CCO-engine booking with no existing booking changed before commit.
